name: tiles-onpolicy-dev2
supersedes: the 'screen' block of experiments/tiles-onpolicy.json (that file is left byte-identical: the T3 checkpoint and scripts/tiles_onpolicy_gate.py are bound to it); its offline gate and on_fail rule are unchanged
decision: Jerry 2026-11-10: 'yes match todays policy' (docs/PLAN.md evaluation policy: no heuristic tables; control = served bot; self table = three copies of the served bot; seeded JSettlers at screen stage).
runs_only_if: the T3 offline gate (runs/tiles-onpolicy-v1/gate.json) has pass == true; otherwise recorded, no screen
candidate: planner_pv2_tiles_t3: planner_pv2_tiles_buyfix purchase scoring (PR #59) + on-policy weights from runs/tiles-onpolicy-v1/tiles.pt; bundled per the owner's decision; a pass supports the bundle, not either change alone
gate: PASS iff both: (1) self_served point lift >= +.02 with the evaluator's gates (0 truncations, latency); (2) JSettlers scripts/jsettlers_paired.py --point-bar 0.02 'dev_pass' (paired point won(t3) - won(tiles) >= +.02, identical setups, 0 bridge errors, all games completed, <= 5% excluded).
power: As exact-dev2: self_served .945 (400 seeds, sigma .25, alternative +.04) x JSettlers .861 (per-game SD .59, 1024 pairs) = .814.
next: A pass leads to a separately predeclared held-out (self_served sized from the DEV point with variance_floor .10, >= 512 seeds; 2048 paired JSettlers games; STAC POMCP with trading reported). A fail is recorded.
note: Predeclared 2026-11-10 before the T3 offline gate outcome was read.
